title: Portal Second Age: card flavor text

entities.name: Tojira
entities.description: Swamp queen whose heart is evil and who commands nightstalkers.

entities.name: Alaborn
entities.description: Human kingdom whose army has soldiers, grenadiers and musketeers.

entities.name: Trokin
entities.description: City with a gate and festival, guarded by troops.

entities.name: Dakmor
entities.description: Region of bats, plague and scorpions.

entities.name: Nightstalkers
entities.description: Swamp creatures serving Tojira, with steeds that need prey.

entities.name: Goblins
entities.description: Goblins who raid and are preyed upon.

entities.name: Norwood
entities.description: Elvish forest with archers, rangers and riders.

events.summary: An Alaborn soldier jeers at a fleeing enemy who ran from the barrel.
Restela says bravery shines brightest in a pure soul.
events.quote: Bravery shines brightest in a pure soul.

events.summary: Jefan explains that Talas merchants sell information or pirates use it.
events.quote: Our merchants sell it, or our pirates use it.

events.summary: Arathel complains that Talas ships pollute the air and forest.
events.quote: Their ships pollute our air as they themselves pollute our forest.

events.summary: Jefan says scouting a battle before fighting is good business.
events.quote: Scouting a battle before you fight it is just good business.

events.summary: Tojira claims deeper rage than her enemies.
events.quote: I have all the weapons my enemies have—and far deeper rage.

events.summary: Restela laments that the greatest hope has become the enemy's greatest triumph.
events.quote: Our greatest hope has become our enemy's greatest triumph.

events.summary: Restela contrasts Alaborn steeds with nightstalker steeds that need prey.
Tojira calls raising the dead a shortcut in the natural cycle.
events.quote: Life from death is part of the natural cycle. This is merely a shortcut.

events.summary: Jefan complains about facing the heat of battle.
events.quote: This isn't what I meant by 'facing the heat of battle!'

events.summary: Arathel says every seed planted teaches the forest.
events.quote: Every seed planted is another lesson the forest can teach us.

events.summary: Arathel declares what was taken shall be restored.
events.quote: What was taken shall be restored.
